decision_summary_zh: 床头和床垫主体可辨认，木质深棕与床品浅色也基本正确；但输入中的黑色枕头负空间被重建成了大块深蓝实体，并在床头附近与床垫融合。该错误会与后续独立枕头重叠，不能作为统一视觉和碰撞主体。

candidate_comparison.reason: Seed46 has the larger, more asymmetric dark solid mound and a less continuous mattress silhouette than seed47.

blocking_issues.explanation: The removed-pillow cavity is reconstructed as a large asymmetric solid mound at the head of the bed. The top and side views prove that the region is positive geometry rather than preserved empty space or a completed mattress surface.

A black alpha hole in the observed RGBA has become a saturated dark-blue material region. This color has no valid bed-surface evidence and would remain visible after independent white pillows are inserted.
The generated blue mass is fused into the mattress and headboard region. Reintroducing the separately modeled pillows would cause obvious visual and collision overlap.

warnings.explanation: The light bedspread is smoothed and smeared in places. This alone would be acceptable, but it is secondary to the blocking solid-mass error.

positive_evidence: The wooden headboard and long mattress silhouette are recognizable.
The intended dark-brown headboard and light bedding categories are largely retained outside the occlusion region.
All six canonical object-local views rendered without browser console errors.

scene_review.reason: Canonical geometry review failed before Bedroom4 adoption.
